subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost produce `reply_to_bot` by default for replies beneath bot-authored thread roots, with operators opting out through the shared `implicitMentions.replyToBot` policy?
rationale: This is a deliberate default message-delivery behavior change rather than a mechanical defect; the shared policy makes it configurable, but only maintainers can accept its default activation semantics.

options.title: Adopt the shared-policy behavior
options.body: Correct the contradictory docs and accept default-on `reply_to_bot`, relying on the existing account/channel/default opt-out for deployments that require explicit mentions.

options.title: Require runtime confirmation first
options.body: Keep the direction but request a redacted Mattermost thread roundtrip before approving the default-on behavior.

options.title: Decline default-on activation
options.body: Do not merge if Mattermost should remain explicit-mention-only unless an operator enables a future dedicated behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared-policy behavior
recommendation.body: Correct the contradictory docs and accept default-on `reply_to_bot`, relying on the existing account/channel/default opt-out for deployments that require explicit mentions.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded review comment specifies the intended shared-policy integration and is the clearest available decision signal.
